events.summary: Hasal, Elishta and Maklo flee a gargantuan and run past Domri Rade, freshly planeswalked.
events.quote: They ran past Domri Rade , freshly planeswalked for the first time

events.summary: An elf pulls Domri into a cave until the gargantuan passes.
events.quote: pulled him into a dark cave until the gargantuan had passed them by

events.summary: Hasal questions Domri, who describes Ravnica and the Gruul.
events.quote: an entire world made of buildings

events.summary: Domri accidentally planeswalks away again, making the elves among the first to witness a planeswalk.
